name: pickup_create_spawn_def_and_link
description: Pickup::CreateSpawnDefAndLink optionally links a pickup object into the pickup scene node, allocates and populates a PickupSpawnDef from the pickup name metadata and transform inputs, appends it to the primary spawn list, and propagates the spawn context through the pickup subtree.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup spawn/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41d920 validates the optional AddChild(g_Pickup_SceneNode, pickupObj) call, 0x54-byte malloc, PickupType search by typeIndex, pickupId/type/amount loads from pickupObj->name offsets 0x18/0x1c/0x20, position copy, nullable rotation copy-or-zero, primary spawn-list append, and SetContextRecursive flag mask 0x240000.

The native pickup leaf smoke verifies populated PickupSpawnDef fields, nullable rotation handling, primary-list head/tail/count updates, optional scene linkage through AddChild, and recursive callback-context/flag propagation.
